title: settings (server to Nunki)
description: The announcer's name and room as the server holds them: after `welcome` (before `round`) and whenever they change, never twice the same in a row - except with `error`, which answers a request that was turned down and carries what still holds. The device shows this, not what it asked for.

room.description: A room of the tournament, empty for none, or free text from before the tournament had rooms (which restricts nothing).
